note: v3340: MY OWN v3333 BROKE TWO DOCTOR LAWS AND CI SAID SO, while the net count hid it. That ship added the doctor check called reel clocks as the HEART half of the session-card fix, a watcher built to JOIN something, and I never joined the watcher itself. It sat in NEITHER explained-registry and declared nothing in WATCHES, so the organ table read ABSENT for it: a claim nobody made, indistinguishable from a check nobody wrote. ⚠ THE NET WAS FLAT AND THAT IS WHAT HID IT. CI went 27 failing to 27 failing across the ship, which reads as nothing moved. Only diffing the LISTS showed two gates fixed and two broken. A count is not a delta. The fix is two entries and both are declarations rather than exemptions. WATCHES gets an empty tuple, which in that map is the honest answer and the idiom its own comment describes: this row has no screen element of its own and reaches him through the eagle line. And the row goes in NO_JOINT_YET rather than COVERED_BY, because I have no joint to cite. Nothing pairs it with a second independent source today, and the law that checks a covered claim cites a joint that actually runs would rightly refuse a coverage claim I cannot back. The gate pins the CODE, this row watches the DATA, and neither corroborates the other. ⚠ A REAL JOINT IS AVAILABLE AND UNBUILT and the entry says so: the console own session list and the reel ids on disk are two genuinely independent sources for the same question. Building it would move this row to COVERED_BY honestly, and that is heart-first work rather than a registry edit. 6 red-proofs PROVEN across the two laws. ⚠ SAME SHAPE AS THE FEEDER BEAT, TWICE IN ONE NIGHT: building a watcher is not the join, THE REGISTRATION IS THE JOIN.
